messages:
jordan: deploy-bot is warning about eu-west1 rollout (p95 up, error spike). Auto-revert window in ~4m. Ideas?
deploy-bot: ALERT: rollout eu-west1 detected p95 410ms (+200ms) and 3.1% 5xxs over 3m. Auto-revert scheduled in 4m. Use /deploybot ack to suppress.
jordan: we shouldn't let it auto-revert unless it's noise. Lina, can you check canary logs and tracing links?
lina: digging in now. Early look: increased tail latency from the new kernel path; some LRU eviction warnings in logs.
colt: If it's kernel-specific, rolling back to previous runtime+model combo is safest. We should consider region-scoped pin to avoid impacting other regions.
jordan: Agreed. Proposal: suppress auto, run a targeted rollback for eu-west1 only to v4.2.1, staged 20 -> 60 -> 100 over 8m steps. Sam take customer comms please.
deploy-bot: INFO: pending ack to suppress auto-revert.
sam: Draft for customers: "We've detected elevated errors in EU. We're rolling the region back to restore service; no action needed. ETA ~15m." Send to ops-customer-alerts after rollback completes.
elena: I'll ack suppression and start investigation. Command: ```/deploybot ack suppress --tid 1748519999 --by elena --reason "investigate kernel latency" --until 2026-04-01T09:05:00Z```
deploy-bot: CONFIRMED: suppression acked by elena until 2026-04-01T09:05:00Z (id sup-12b4). Monitoring interval continues.
lina: Traces show increased queueing inside worker threads when request size > 2k tokens; might be batching config interaction with new kernel.
colt: That matches a change in batching heuristics in v4.3.0. Rollback target v4.2.1 is fine. Note: two Dedicated customers in eu-west1 will see routing change, notify accounts.
jordan: Execute staged rollback. Command: ```/deploybot rollout set-version --region eu-west1 --version v4.2.1 --traffic 20% --staged --step-duration 480s --thread 1748519999```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Started staged rollback to v4.2.1 in eu-west1. Step 1: route 20% to v4.2.1.
sam: Pinged account reps for BetaBank and DataStream; they're on standby.
lina: After step 1, p95 dropped to 220ms, errors 0.6%. Good sign. KV cache miss spike but recovered in ~90s.
jordan: Proceed to 60%. ```/deploybot rollout continue --to 60% --thread 1748519999```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Advanced to 60% at 2026-04-01T09:00:45Z.
elena: Watching for regressions from state mismatch; so far no customer-facing 5xxs.
lina: Telemetry at 60%: p95 200ms, 5xxs 0.3%. Clear to finish.
jordan: Finish to 100% and pin for 12h. ```/deploybot rollout continue --to 100% --thread 1748519999 && /deploybot pin-version --region eu-west1 --version v4.2.1 --duration 12h```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Rollback to v4.2.1 completed to 100% at 2026-04-01T09:06:40Z. Pin applied for 12h. Telemetry now p95 195ms, 5xx 0.2%.
sam: Posted customer blurb to ops-customer-alerts. Rep replies: "Thanks, keep us posted."
jordan: Post-action items: open a postmortem ticket, include steps to adjust batching heuristics and add an alert for kernel-path latency change. Also add a rule so deploy-bot's auto-revert threshold incorporates token-size distribution.
elena: Also add a short runbook note: when suppressing auto-reverts, set a suppression TTL and an owner. We almost forgot to set the 12h pin earlier.
colt: Good call. I'll file the runbook PR and include the staged rollback command snippets.
jordan: Thanks team. Quick sync in 30m to capture notes for the postmortem. :thumbsup:
